children: Sweden motion capture tech firm's preliminary Q3 net sales fell 15% yr/yr
Preliminary Q3 operating profit dropped sharply due to lower volumes and commercialization costs
Shortfall driven by delayed orders, US funding constraints, and Middle East geopolitical uncertainty
Company says financial targets remain unchanged
VOLUME DROP - Co said lower sales volumes contributed to decline in operating profit
COMMERCIALIZATION COSTS - Co attributed lower EBIT margin to costs related to markerless technology roll-out
DELAYED ORDERS - Co said shortfall was mainly due to delayed orders from constrained US research funding and Middle East geopolitical uncertainty
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Qualisys Holding AB (publ) is SEK69.00, about 34.8% above its October 19 closing price of SEK51.20
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
